## 📊 Copilot usage and ROI report **CoolEngOrg** · organization · 2026-09-06 to 2026-09-19 (14 days with data) | Metric | Value | | ------ | ----- | | Total cost | **$704.48** | | AI credits | 70,448.3 ($704.48) | | Active / engaged users | 16 / 13 (81% engaged) | | Merged pull requests | 39 (18% Copilot-authored) | | Cost per merged PR | **$18.06** (AI only $18.06) | | Median time to merge | n/a | | Code acceptance rate | 39% · 15,845 AI-assisted lines added | ### Findings - 13 of 16 active Copilot users (81%) were engaged: they accepted code or used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, cloud agent) on the day. - 44% of active users used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, Copilot app or cloud agent) at least once. - Copilot-authored pull requests were 18% of 39 merged pull requests. - Total cost per merged pull request: $18.06 (AI credits alone: $18.06). - AI-credit spend in the second half of the period changed -25% versus the first half.

📦 **Artifacts:** [download the report bundle](https://github.com/CoolEngOrg/issueops/actions/runs/9100020201/artifacts/4200000202) (interactive `copilot-roi.html` with table views), `report.json`. Artifacts are retained for 30 days. 📈 Metrics were pushed to the Pushgateway and appear on the **IssueOps / Copilot ROI** Grafana dashboard.
Notes and definitions - Teams with fewer than five Copilot-seated users are omitted from GitHub's user-teams report; users on several teams count toward each of their teams, so team rows do not sum to the scope total. - AI-assisted lines of code (loc_added_sum) are directional: they measure Copilot-suggested lines accepted or applied, not total output. - **AI cost**: ai_credits_used x $0.0100 per credit (config pricing.ai_credit_usd) - **active user**: a Copilot-seated user with any interaction, generation, acceptance or agent use on a day - **cost per merged PR**: total cost in scope / merged pull requests in scope - **cycle time**: pull request created -> merged, in hours - **engaged user**: accepted code or used an agentic surface (agent mode, CLI, cloud agent) on the day - **seat cost**: seats x $39.00 per month x days/30 (Copilot Enterprise)
